summary: Name publish-only actions in apply previews for metadata-only agent changes and non-launch declarations.

replay.detail: No stored claims or replay behavior change.

schema.detail: Preview actions remain string-valued; no generated client or storage schema changes are required.

compatibility.detail: Apply preview predicted_actions now includes publish-only for description/grouping-only agent changes with or without a harness, and changed declarations without a member launch. Consumers should admit this explicit non-launch action. Existing launch, interruption and suspension actions are retained.

downtime.detail: Preview-only classification; no daemon restart or runtime action is introduced.

recovery.detail: Earlier binaries retain their previous preview classification.
